title: Remote computer-use leases and isolation
objective: Add explicit, locally authorized remote computer-use leases without weakening Quntal's existing remote principal/device/session model. A remote provider may receive only the exact locally selected browser/desktop capabilities, targets, workspace, device, provider/principal, route epoch, expiry, and policy revision bound into one revocable lease. Remote approval, self-grant, background screen streaming, surprise queued execution, and cross-provider/session reuse remain denied.

include: server-issued RemoteComputerUseLease bound to verified provider kind, remote principal, device ID, remote connection/session/route epoch, workspace, selected capability set, selected browser profile/pages and/or desktop windows where applicable, policy/trust revision, issue time, hard expiry, and revocation state
local-only lease creation/update/revoke flow using the required local presence/approval class with human-readable exact scope
separate scope classes for browser structured observation/actuation, desktop observation/capture, structured UIA actuation, and coordinate fallback; no implicit union
default-deny remote mapping for every computer-use capability until locally enabled and lease-bound
on-demand bounded observations only; no continuous/background screen stream
remote disconnect/reconnect, token refresh, route change, provider change, device revoke, workspace/trust/policy change, lock/logoff, and local emergency revoke invalidation semantics
no offline queue for mutations and no automatic retry after dispatch; idempotent read retry only where existing remote semantics permit and original lease/request expiry remains valid

tests for cross-provider/principal/device/session/route replay, lease widening attempts, revoked/expired lease, stale target, disconnect races, remote self-approval/self-grant, and compromised-relay routing ambiguity
exclude: remote creation or widening of leases

authority_delta.filesystem: No new generic filesystem authority; remote computer-use follows the exact existing/local tool authority of the leased capability.
authority_delta.network: Remote transport may carry bounded computer-use requests/results already authorized by the lease; no generic proxy/tunnel authority is added.
authority_delta.browser: Specific live browser capabilities may be remotely reachable only under an exact locally created lease and existing local kernel policy.
authority_delta.ui_input: Specific structured desktop and, if explicitly locally enabled, lower-ceiling coordinate actions may be remotely requested only under exact lease + local policy/approval; raw input streams remain absent.
authority_delta.secrets: Remote responses remain data-minimized and governed by local protected-surface/secret rules; no new credential-store authority.
authority_delta.approval: Remote callers cannot approve, create, widen, refresh, or extend local authority. Required action approvals remain local.
authority_delta.privileged: None; no remote elevation or secure-desktop reach.

invariants: remote connectivity never equals local authorization
every remote computer-use request is bounded by one exact active lease plus normal local policy/approval
mutations are not queued or retried after dispatch

acceptance.claim: A locally created lease can expose only its exact selected capabilities/targets to one verified provider/principal/device/session route for a bounded duration, with all other computer-use surfaces denied.

Cross-provider/principal/device/session/route replay, lease widening, remote self-grant/approval, expired/revoked lease, stale target, policy/trust/workspace drift, disconnect/reconnect races, and compromised-relay misrouting fail closed.
No background stream, offline mutation queue, duplicate automatic retry, whole-device control, generic shell/socket/proxy, security-dialog reach, or remote elevation is introduced.
Local revoke/emergency stop/lock/logoff/device revoke invalidates active remote computer-use authority promptly and deterministically.
Exact-head local+remote integration tests, CI, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, security review, and zero unresolved blockers pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000085: Program-wide security/privacy/performance qualification may activate only after local and remote execution paths are fully specified and implemented.

done_when: Remote computer use is canonically constrained by exact local leases and existing kernel authority with provider/device/session isolation and no remote self-grant, background stream, queue, or generic control widening.
